about: Sainte-Anne-des-Plaines is a city in the Lower Laurentians north of Montréal, in the Thérèse-De Blainville area toward Mirabel. Residential neighbourhoods, a traditional village core, and surrounding farm and woodland edges define a North Shore community outside the densest suburbs. About 15,000 people live in Sainte-Anne-des-Plaines.
